newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa slides, coffee stays mixed in PM.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa slides, coffee stays mixed in PM.

text.p: COCOA - Slides, with July breaking support at 1,030 and 1,020.
Volume still mostly in July, May before first notice day. At 1500 GMT, July down 33 at 1,011.
COFFEE - Mixed after Folgers raises 13 oz can of coffee 20 cents, effective immediately. July up $2 at $1,602.
SUGAR - First three months slip, outright sales and Aas depress Aug. Aug off 90 cents at $312.20.
